title: Specified splitting of a truncated etale diagram
statement: For a truncated etale diagram S on X, a specified splitting gives qcqs nondegenerate summands N_n and inclusions such that the cofan indexed by epimorphisms to lower degrees is a coproduct in each degree. The notions used here are those of [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover].

source.place: Detailed form proof: finite simplicial data and finite matching limits

proof.text: Retain the nondegenerate summands, inclusions, and splitting coproducts of the finite split hypercover definition. Each summand itself supplies one finite qcqs component when constructing a hypercover.
